title: Profiteroles
description: Light choux pastry puffs filled with whipped cream and drizzled with warm chocolate ganache. Served with fresh fruit.

ingredients.notes: divided: 60ml whipped to soft peaks (for Filling), 125ml (for Ganache)

method.instruction: Bake choux puffs as per the choux pastry recipe until golden and crisp. Cool completely on a wire rack.
Whip 60 ml of the thickened cream to soft peaks. Using a piping bag fitted with a small nozzle, fill each cooled puff through a small hole made in the base.

For the ganache: heat the remaining 125 ml of thickened cream in a small saucepan over medium-low heat until just simmering — do not boil. Place 200 g of chopped dark chocolate in a heatproof bowl and pour the hot cream over it.
Let the chocolate and cream mixture stand undisturbed for 2 minutes, then stir gently until the chocolate is completely melted and the ganache is smooth and glossy.
Dip the top of each filled puff into the warm ganache, or drizzle it generously over the piled profiteroles.
Serve immediately with fresh seasonal fruit on the side.

notes.title: Choux Pastry
notes.content: Refer to the Choux Pastry recipe in the Baking section for the pastry base. This recipe covers the assembly and finishing — the choux itself is a separate recipe component.

notes.title: Ganache
notes.content: Do not stir the ganache immediately after pouring the cream — letting it sit for 2 minutes allows the chocolate to melt evenly. Stirring too early can cause the ganache to split or become grainy.
